name: resume
description: William R. J. Ribeiro's online resume/CV: a static Svelte 5 + Tailwind CSS 4 site on GitHub Pages

scripts.scotty:up: bun run beads:latest && docker compose up -d --build scotty && printf 'Scotty: http://localhost:%s\n' "${SCOTTY_PORT:-3000}"
scripts.prd: bun run build && SERVE_DIR=build bun scripts/serve-https.ts
scripts.fmt: bun run --parallel --workspaces --if-present fmt && oxfmt scripts src
scripts.lint: bun run --parallel --workspaces --if-present lint && oxlint --disable-nested-config --deny-warnings scripts src
scripts.typecheck: bun --bun svelte-kit sync && bun run --parallel --workspaces --if-present typecheck && bun check
scripts.fmt:check: bun run --parallel --workspaces --if-present fmt:check && oxfmt --check scripts src
scripts.verify: bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error fmt:check lint md:check md:fmt:check typecheck test

author: William R. J. Ribeiro
